title: Self-project pull requests use a concise authored subject and a body that explains approved intent, observed scope, honest evidence and recorded reversibility
acceptance: Why. Self PR creation at fm-worker.sh:2291-2304 copies the entire descriptive task title into the PR title and publishes a one-line pointer. The repository template explicitly documents that bypass. Captain requests proper firstmate self-PR rules with concise subjects and useful intent, verification and door/rollback context. This task does not overhaul external rendering.

Change 1, publication metadata. Add bin/lib/fm_self_pr.py as a data-only validate/seal/render/preview helper. Firstmate authors a self-only operational draft before dispatch under state/pr-authoring/<task>.json: schema version1, task, dispatch approval reference when recorded, spec/contract/conventions digests calculated from the exact approved source bytes (explicit absent conventions sentinel), subject, size small|complex, problem, expected_result, approach, intent_notes indexed against approved explain intents or acceptance lines, door two-way|one-way|mixed|not-recorded with reason, rollback trigger/action/owner/limits or explicit not-recorded. A first dispatch has no publication pin digest yet: the draft never requires one. After stock fm_pin create/resolve returns the authoritative pin, the trusted outer launcher compares draft source digests against pin snapshots, checks the supplied dispatch reference against the actual retained approval when present, and writes a separate sealed derivative with that publication pin digest. A missing/incorrect dispatch reference is never promoted into approval; current session dispatch authorization is still owned by stock dispatch/firstmate rules. Missing or conflicting approved source bytes refuse sealing and request correction; no mutable worktree data is used as authority. Root launcher reads only from real FM_STATE_DIR, rejects symlinks/outside-state resolution, and passes the sealed derivative to the copied renderer. The crew does not create or alter approval/seals. Metadata adds publication prose, not behavior authorization: firstmate reviews reference alignment in the brief; changed intent/scope requires the usual captain rescope. Legacy pins need no repin for prose: firstmate drafts against their retained snapshot digests, then the launcher seals against that existing pin. Publication pin digest is SHA-256 of the ENTIRE validated stock resolved pin JSON encoded UTF-8 with json.dumps(pin,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False). Stock pin has no signature; this derived digest is not an evidence signature and grants no authority. The sealed publication derivative stores schema1, project/task, pin.version and pin_sha256 plus snapshot digests; verification recomputes those from the current stock resolved pin and separately honors stock approval/receipt checks. Do not modify stock pin serialization, history hash, fields or evidence signatures.

Change 2, concrete handoff. In self mode the outer fm-worker validates and seals the publication draft immediately after stock pin create/resolve and before the model adapter or any commit/push/publication. After committing and before existing PR creation, it invokes the copied-code helper with that sealed metadata, pinned spec text, actual task branch head and git diff from confirmed base. Renderer produces JSON title/body and retains an exact preview in self state; worker consumes only those JSON fields with a securely owned temporary body file and existing fm_github --body-file support. Cleanup owns that temporary file. No worker-authored test claim is consumed. A new self PR requires a firstmate-authored meaningful subject and context, including legacy tasks/pins: missing metadata yields an actionable authoring-required refusal before the adapter/commit/push, not a generic title or blind truncation. Firstmate can supply a draft matching an existing pin without captain repin when it changes publication prose only. Existing self PR rounds bypass new-PR authoring requirements and preserve remote metadata. Question-only draft rounds may be discovered after an initially valid implementation envelope; retain draft/question lifecycle and render an explicitly labeled concise question subject/body without claiming implemented behavior, using the authored component subject and recorded question purpose. Do not publish arbitrary worker private paths/question reasoning. Late question handoff maps only existing standalone markers: SCOPE-BLOCKED maps to scope clarification; ASK-PASS-CRITERIA maps to acceptance clarification; other supported ASK-<reason> maps to implementation clarification. The outer launcher passes the bounded enum to the renderer after existing marker detection, together with the already sealed authored component subject; renderer never receives raw $say, marker suffix details, question file bytes or worker reasoning. Subject is Ask about <authored component>; body states only draft awaiting the named clarification, approved intent and pending evidence. Privacy restriction here applies only to new PR title/body generation: existing authorized self question-file/comment lifecycle and separately private external question retention remain unchanged. Tests use path/secret-like worker text and prove none enters generated metadata while original lifecycle remains a regression guard.

Change 3, title quality. Authored subject is one line, 1-70 printable ASCII characters, at most12 words, no newline/control/local-state path references or repeated task-id prefix. Require a first word from Add, Fix, Update, Remove, Preserve, Prevent, Record, Show, Refresh, Support, Validate, Bound, Use, Keep, Replace, Improve, Allow, Reject or Restore followed by a nonempty named object; reject generic subjects exactly equal to Update task, Project work or Update plus the task id. This bounded structural rule is not an NLP adequacy claim. Firstmate judges specificity and final behavior in the brief. Final title is T-id: subject and within85 characters. Tests use a deliberately long task title and a distinct concise subject. Do not modify task.title, branch derivation or commit_msg; commit and branch text retain existing behavior.

Change 4, useful body. Small changes use connected problem/result prose, important approach, observed scope, validation, dispatch decision provenance and door/rollback lines. Complex changes use Problem and result; Approach and scope; Approved intent and evidence table; Decision, migration and rollback. Size is authored, not inferred from line count. Approved expected behavior is explicitly expected, not a claim that every intent passed. Actual implementation context comes from exact-head diff file list; metadata approach is labeled proposed until firstmate verifies it. Include exact head and approved task identity, plus actual verified captain dispatch reference if available, otherwise not recorded. Never fabricate a decision, review, executed test, pass, fail-first result or rollback owner. Missing structured intent is mapped to referenced acceptance purpose without dumping every acceptance line. Missing door/rollback is not recorded. Reuse existing approved door information if present without creating or requiring T242 change_points/door fields on stored task/card schemas.

Change 5, truthful evidence. The body labels a timestamped Status at PR creation for exact head H: required CI, review and six gates pending/not collected; local validation not recorded. This initial implementation consumes no passed-evidence input, so it cannot manufacture success. Say Check current CI and review at this PR, linking the self repository branch/head or PR when known; do not present initial pending status as a permanent current-readiness claim. The renderer receives the GitHub repository identity from trusted self project config and constructs commit links from that plus validated H; no private pin/state/local path is published. Body regeneration after CI is not introduced. Firstmate may later include verified evidence only through a separately reviewed metadata update preview. Test-only/docs classification may be stated only from approved contract and actual diff, with limits. Reviewer judges factual prose by pin/diff/evidence, but missing or pending creation-time results are not a new rejection criterion, approval marker or gate. Body remains informative prose, never readiness evidence. Self GitHub identity lookup uses the resolved self project name and fm_project_get <name> github "$FM_CONFIG" when registry is usable, not external-only GH_REPO. For legacy/degraded self callers, derive owner/repo only from a canonical GitHub HTTPS or SSH origin URL already available in the real repository; do not fetch network. Validate exactly owner/repo with existing repository grammar. Missing/unknown/non-GitHub identity omits hyperlinks and prints current evidence unavailable in the body; it does not fail an otherwise valid legacy round or publish the raw origin/local path. Test registered self, pre-registry canonical GitHub origin and local-bare fixture origin with links absent. Subject/intent still require valid authoring.

Change 6, existing PR and external safety. Only new self PR creation changes by default. Later rounds preserve remote title/body, including human edits; adopted and every external PR retain existing public-title/body template code byte behavior. Preview command takes self repository/task/PR/head and current title/body hashes and emits proposed metadata only; it makes no network mutation. Current open self PR metadata repair is an optional concrete per-PR captain decision identifying the exact PR/head/old hashes/new preview. This task grants no blanket repair or automatic all-project edits. A firstmate authorized operator can later apply a reviewed preview after remote CAS checks using existing GitHub interface; no new editor implementation is in scope.

Change 7, rules/documentation. Replace .github/pull_request_template.md one-line-override comment and stale branch-spec assertions with matching small/complex firstmate self rules. Edit existing design §5.4 Pull request protocol in place, no terminal section. Worker role states source and handoff, reviewer states factual prose judgment without treating pending statuses as a rejection criterion, firstmate states envelope authoring, exact preview review and human/adopted metadata preservation. External repository templates and captain-confirmed conventions remain upstream; do not change fm_pr_format.py, fm_public_text.py, fm_onboard.py or external policy schema.

Tests and fail-first. New feature-owned wrapper/helper use disposable repo/state, stock resolved pin fixtures and mocked GitHub only. Assert authored short title rather than long task title; small/complex meaningful sections; actual diff scope and exact head; all new CI/test/review claims pending; missing authoring refusal versus invalid/seal-digest refusal; digest mismatch, symlink, bad intent index, multiline/control title, quoted Markdown and shell metacharacters, absent door/rollback, first-dispatch unsealed draft sealed after stock pin creation and legacy pin sealed without repin, question draft, existing self metadata unchanged and copied FM_CODE_ROOT helper lookup. External public-title and private-spec leakage fixtures remain regression guards; update extraction fixture only if worker boundaries change. For base proof retain the harness and renderer API, replace creation rendering with old long-title/one-line behavior, and fail concrete content assertions, not missing imports. Ordinary full gates run current implementation/tests; static brief rules do not prove model compliance. Shared self worker fixture tests/lib/worker.sh gains seed_self_pr_authoring(repo,task) that derives draft snapshot digests from the same exact stock-approved source/contract helpers, authors bounded meaningful fixture subject and metadata, and copies new renderer into disposable engine. Call it after standard fixture seeding and after any fixture spec/contract/config replacement; never disable or stub the production seal checks. Scope includes tests/spec-pin-worker.test.sh after contract change and tests/worker-lifecycle.test.sh new T-N cases explicitly. Consumers inventoried: local-round-loop, spec-pin-worker, worker-mirror, spec-preflight-worker, worker-draft-ready, worker-exits, spec-pin-sync, worker-checkpoint, worker-auth, unsent, worker-scratch, worker-executable, worker-policy, worker-liveness, worker-lifecycle, worker-retry, worker-rebuild, worker-branch-recovery, worker-notes, worker-ci-evidence, stacking-worker and worker-rebuild-publication. Refresh only actual changed source fixture sites; preserve each original behavior/negative assertion. bin/fm-canary.sh builds an independent destroy workload: author a valid self draft matching its approved scratch task/contract before calling stock worker, without real repository writes or policy bypass; its destroy workload remains covered by tests/canary.test.sh. External extraction tests/lib/external_public_title.py must replace its explicit old self long-title/one-line-body expectation even if extraction boundaries do not change; retain external byte and leakage checks. New render/seal/refusal cases are feature assertions; lifecycle/external output and destroy safety are regression guards. Complete retained r1b standing items12 and18. Add tests/lib/worker-rebuild.sh to shared fixture inventory: rb_build_fixture rewrites task/design and RB_PINNED config at lines18-34, commits approved sources, then seed_spec_preflight before worker line68. Reseed the authored draft using exact resulting approved source/config/contract bytes after all these replacements and approval setup, immediately before stock worker. Preserve original pinned synchronization, replay, rebuild and hook assertions; no stale draft and no sealing bypass. Independent tests/e2e-loop.test.sh creates task/config at47-57, stock preflight setup and real ready/dispatch at95-98; seed valid authored draft from exact approved snapshot/authorization after final source setup and before real dispatch. Independent tests/crew-end-to-end.test.sh creates both tasks53-57 and launches both real workers117-120; seed separate valid meaningful drafts and stock-approved snapshot/authorization fixtures for both tasks before dispatch. Adapt only its repository/account mock as needed to faithfully supply real stock resolver inputs, never stub renderer sealing or manufacture authorization outside fixture isolation. Keep dispatch-to-merge and distinct crew actor/identity assertions intact as regression guards. Feature-owned tests assert these fixture drafts match final contract bytes, and missing/stale data still refuses; successful old end-to-end behavior is regression verification, not evidence of new rendering fail-first. Existing historical split manifest tracks worker-rebuild helper; make changes additive at seeding boundary while preserving all its original non-comment lines and assertion multiplicity, requiring no exemption or manifest change. If this cannot be achieved stop and report exact needed scope before editing. Complete retained r1c standing19, newMISSED19. Add tests/lib/herdr.py EntrypointsFixture to independent consumer inventory: copies bin/skills at214-229, creates T-035 task/config at232-234, currently seeds only preflight236. Seed valid authored draft and stock-approved snapshot/authorization from final task/design/config/contract fixture bytes before real self worker launch; adapt repository/account Git mock at440 only to supply faithful final approved bytes/identity/diff inputs needed by the real resolver/rendering. No seal/authority stub. Shared consumer modules tests/herdr/windows.py, tests/herdr/transport.py and tests/herdr/handoff.py must remain reachable and preserve host, snapshot, transport, parent-child handoff and lifeline assertions as regression guards, including windows306 completion and windows513 model-start paths. Add tests/herdr/windows.py to exact scope because its concurrent worker/reviewer test rewrites config.yaml at643 after base fixture seeding; explicitly reseed final approved source and authored draft there before launches. Do not auto-refresh every invoke or silently repair intentional missing/stale metadata; feature-owned tests in tests/lib/self_pr_authoring.py must exercise EntrypointsFixture final approved draft digests, publication through real stock seal, missing and stale draft refusal without adapter/model startup. Direct subprocess/Popen consumers must receive setup already completed, not rely solely on invoke wrapper. Review-only config replacements in handoff do not publish new self worker PR and require no authoring repair. Transport/handoff consumers require no production or test-module behavior changes beyond shared setup; if additional source replacement affecting real self PR is discovered report exact required scope rather than bypassing checks. Complete retained r1d standing20 MISSED20. Inventory fourth EntrypointsFixture consumer tests/herdr/credentials.py (class at3), wrapper tests/herdr-credentials.test.sh:7, alongside windows/transport/handoff and their corresponding herdr-*.test.sh wrappers. recorded_environment_case(True) at credentials8 appends billing config in scoped helper tests/lib/herdr.py:602 after setup; explicitly reseed stock-approved final source/snapshot/authorization plus authored draft after that billing append and before first real worker605. False branch keeps base fixture authoring; both worker windows and headless launches still finish614. New feature-owned tests verify API-billing final-config digest seals using production helper, and deliberately removed/stale drafts refuse before model starts without invoke-time repair. Preserve all credential allowlist, other-vendor-login exclusion, private token leakage, copied-code config exclusion and sandbox network assertions as regression guards; do not publish billing credentials or raw source config in PR text. No credentials consumer/wrapper edit is inherently necessary: helper already scoped. Exhaustive EntrypointsFixture conditional-mutation inventory: repository search finds exactly four subclasses windows.py207, transport.py3, handoff.py3, credentials.py3. Shared setUp task/design/config232-234 needs initial approved seed. Shared recorded_environment_case billing602 requires explicit reseed because it runs full workers. Shared handed_environment_case billing643 directly invokes execute_child on handcrafted adapter receipt and never runs publication/pin resolution: preserve its allowlist tests without artificial PR authoring. windows.py219 project-sync config replacement is sync-only; windows604 host-choice rewrites config for window_host-only; neither launches new PR and needs no reseed. windows643 concurrent worker/reviewer config replacement does launch worker and is already scoped with explicit reseed. handoff109 fallback config mutation is review-only; credentials36-44 billing-loop changes call round_environment only, credentials75 fallback change is review-only. All require existing behavior unchanged. Transport changes adapter code only, with no task/design/config replacement; shared final setup covers real worker Popen. Handoff direct Popen workers likewise consume base final setup. Credentials real-dispatch test config unchanged after base setup; its fixture readiness A before fm-dispatch preserves lawful authorization and already prepared matching draft. No consumer blanket reseeding and no snapshot-source retroactive rewrite. Maintain complete four-consumer regression reachability through wrappers, not merely new feature suite.

Migration. Old frozen code sessions continue prior PR output until self-update/new code snapshot. New updated rounds apply this policy; legacy specs/pins remain valid, new-PR rounds with missing metadata pause for firstmate to author matching prose before the adapter starts; existing-PR rounds continue unchanged. Existing PRs receive no automatic edit or status refresh. Draft/sealed envelope schema is additive operational state, no evidence/pin/card format migration. No stored T242 door schema is changed. No new network read/write is introduced except existing PR creation; preview reads supplied exact remote snapshot data. No external records copied into self state. Add an explicit old/new frozen-code migration test: a disposable retained old code root keeps old long-title/one-line self output, while the updated snapshot with new helper validates metadata and emits the concise/rich output; ensure retained snapshot bytes remain unchanged. Use full retained harness/APIs, not missing helper import as proof. Valid legacy pins acquire no new repin requirement solely for publication prose. Existing stock legacy-authorization restriction and tests/legacy-pin-repin.test.sh remain fully enforced; invalid legacy authorization still requires its existing approved repin. Metadata sealing cannot waive that restriction.

Out of scope. External format overhaul; auto rewriting existing PRs; commit/task/branch title changes; approval/review/gate or CI refresh policy; tests executed by workers; fabricated evidence; captain merge approval.
